title: Recipe index
lead: Mirror recipe files into SQLite on each sync, preserving metadata and parse confirmations (R5, ADR 0006).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** ingredient parsing (lines are stored raw here and parsed later); UI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The planner and list query recipes from the DB. Re-syncing must never lose UI-edited metadata.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
None. Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, if a recipe file is deleted from the repo larder archives the recipe (hides it from browse and planning, keeps its metadata so restoring the file brings it back intact).

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, answered in the spec check: (1) recipe_source has kind recipe-repo and location the constant 'recipes', and recipe.source_ref is the repo-relative path recipes/<slug>.md (never a URL); (2) a renamed file is a new recipe and the old slug is archived, its metadata staying on the archived row and returning if the old name comes back; no matching heuristic.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, spec-check answer: the index hooks into sync inside repo.py: repo.py calls the index (it opens its own DB connection from Settings) after each successful pull or commit, inside the recipes lock, so every caller gets it; an index failure is logged and does not fail the sync. src/larder/recipes/repo.py and its tests join this slice's files.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Walk the repo; parse each file; compute a content hash.
2. Upsert recipes by slug; replace ingredient lines only when the hash changes; keep `recipe_meta` and `parse_override`.
3. Archive recipes that are missing from the repo.
4. Hook into sync: index after every pull or commit.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Index tests pass; indexing the imported recipes yields one row per file.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Add the recipe index built from the recipe repo (S13).
